title: Optical illusions, playable sound and editable media workflows
summary: Today’s expanded review adds perceptual art and engraving/descreening to the effective search plan. Full guides cover transformed-view diffusion, interactive visual studios, game music, neural video preparation and earlier screened creative production tools. Every included software license was read in full or compared against a complete previously reviewed grant; model, asset and service limits remain separate. These are documentation reviews, not installations or hands-on output tests. Quality unverified remains the default when evidence is incomplete; Experimental is reserved for explicit current implementation limitations. Existing Upscayl and Nerfstudio evidence notes also receive targeted support follow-ups: user-reported workarounds are recorded, while remaining workflow gaps keep both Quality unverified. The library gains 41 distinct tools; 18 earlier screened entries become full guides. The complete retained catalog was scanned at the metadata level, followed by bounded manual metadata review and targeted primary-source reads beyond the automatic README shortlist, including a final pass after collection. This was not a manual eligibility review of every search result; raw unreviewed matches remain private. All 434 planned repository queries and 17 model tasks were attempted across 58 fields. Repository search outcomes: 434 successful, 0 partial and 0 failed; 108 reached result bounds. Model query failures: 0. Coverage is not exhaustive. All eight configured web ecosystems have researched findings. Some primary pages returned script shells or failed to load; these limitations are disclosed in the field and source-group notes. Model metadata is a discovery signal, not permission to publish unreviewed software. The collection records 114 warnings, including source retrieval and bounded-search disclosures retained in the report coverage details.

demo.text: The README shows a Raspberry Pi case and links an external rover made through the MCP server. Its 75-of-76 reference-part checks are limited geometry comparisons, not proof of universal CAD equivalence or physically printable output.

installation.text: Install an official desktop release and ensure solidcraft-cli is available, or build the documented Rust source. Connect a compatible external AI agent to the MCP server; use a small headless design before enabling the optional live-app bridge.
